title: Goofy Ahh Baby
blurb: Infant audio dragged into the goofy ahh dimension, where nothing stays sincere for long. Chaotic, slightly wrong, inexplicably funny: the youngest possible generation already committed to the bit. The genre works by taking something with no business being distorted and distorting it anyway, and babies are about as far from ironic as a source material gets. Play it over baby content, over adults behaving childishly, over anybody's origin story. Born goofy, exactly as the prophecy foretold.
